title: The Incredible Sounds of the Falcon Heavy Launch (BINAURAL AUDIO IMMERSION) - Smarter Every Day 189
summary: Smarter Every Day shares a binaural audio recording of the SpaceX Falcon Heavy launch made by Trevor Mahlmann, with explanations of the sounds including the sonic booms of the landing boosters. It is meant to be heard with headphones.
why: Recommended in launch threads as an immersive way to hear what a Falcon Heavy launch actually sounds like.

quote.text: the sonic booms of the boosters coming into land are amazing, listen with headphones!
